## What's new
- **Remove a downloaded model from disk.** In Download Models, a model you downloaded now has a **Remove from disk** button. It asks on the card first, then moves the model's folder to the Trash, so you can restore it from Finder or download it again at any time. It waits while the model is loaded, loading or still downloading, and never touches a copy you placed on your Mac yourself. Available on macOS 15 and later; on macOS 14, Download Models keeps showing the model's folder in Finder.
## Security
- Download controls, Reveal in Finder and Remove from disk now answer only Astronomical's own pages, so another website open on your Mac cannot start downloads, open folders or remove models. The command-line tool is unaffected.
## Compatibility
Existing settings and downloaded models carry over unchanged; no configuration settings were removed. Requires macOS 14 or later on Apple silicon.
This release is signed with a Developer ID certificate and notarized by Apple.
